pnad_metadata.source: IBGE official public microdata (explicit fallback after BigQuery auth/access failure)
pnad_metadata.universe: Persons aged 14+ occupied in reference week (VD4002=1); main-job characteristics; all Brazil
pnad_metadata.cnpj: V4019: 1 registered, 2 not registered, other/missing unknown for employer/self-employed
pnad_metadata.hours: V4039 habitual main job; V4039C actual main job; contracted hours unavailable
pnad_metadata.wage_bridge: Positive VD4016 habitual monthly income and valid habitual main-job hours, same observations in payroll and hours denominators; monthly-to-weekly factor 12/52; formal/informal ratio
pnad_metadata.uncertainty: Point estimates using survey weights; no design-based standard errors; no claim of identified structural parameters

metadata.employment_denominator: occupied persons in agriculture, industry or services; national unclassified CNAE excluded
metadata.capital_hypothesis: K_sector proportional to legacy 2021 VAB shares; K fixed, not an observed capital stock
metadata.sector_model_scope: one representative group per sector; fixed sector employment and capital; no IO, no worker incidence
metadata.hours_scope: main job; PNAD habitual/actual hours are distinct from contracted hours
metadata.omega_source: Sigma=1.326; common technology weight calibrated to observed hourly remuneration ratio using summed sector payrolls
metadata.habitual_hours_policy_mapping: Baseline min(h_habitual,H0) preserves all observed hours because H0 is at least max support; H0 is an identity operation, not the legal cap. Reform min(h_habitual,h1) is a policy mapping assumption, not contracted hours data.
metadata.efficiency_extrapolation: The same efficiency curve anchored at 42.244h is extrapolated over the full empirical hours support; long-hours and part-time responses are assumptions, not estimated behavior.
metadata.welfare: representative-agent diagnostics; sector values do not constitute worker incidence
